Income-Qualified Weatherization

Home Weatherization for Income-Qualified Customers
 

See if you qualify for a no-cost home energy assessment and upgrades to improve your home's energy efficiency, comfort, and safety.

About Benefits Eligibility Income Qualification Guidelines Get Started Home Energy Assessments FAQs
About
Weatherization helps make your home more comfortable and energy efficient by reducing drafts, improving insulation, sealing ducts, and upgrading inefficient heating and cooling systems.

Income-qualified New Jersey residential customers could be eligible for a no-cost home energy assessment and upgrades through our Weatherization Income Qualified and Comfort Partners programs.
BACK TO TOP 
Benefits
No-Cost Energy Upgrades
Receive upgrades that help make your home more energy-efficient at no cost to you.
Energy Savings
Better weatherization can help your home use less energy.
Increased Comfort
Improved sealing and insulation can lead to a more comfortable and consistent home temperature year-round.
Reduce Emissions
Using less energy can help lower greenhouse gas emissions and reduce your home’s carbon footprint.
BACK TO TOP 
Eligibility
New Jersey residential customers may be eligible for one of these income-qualified energy efficiency programs. You must:

Have an electric account in your name for your primary residence, which is only for your unit and not shared with any other residence.
Use the property as your primary residence. Tenant or renter would need landlord or property manager permission prior to comprehensive upgrades.
Live in a building with no more than 14 units that are individually metered to qualify for the Comfort Partners program.
Live in a building with no more than 4 units that are individually metered to qualify for the Home Weatherization for Income-Qualified program
Have a household income within the program’s eligible income range or receive assistance through a qualifying program (see income guidelines below).

BACK TO TOP 
Get Started
Step 1: Apply
Customers can apply to either program by calling Rockland Electric at 646-983-9508
Step 2: Complete Your Home Energy Assessment
Depending on the program you qualify for, you’ll complete a Home Energy Assessment or a more in-depth Home Energy Assessment Plus to identify recommended home improvements.
Step 3: Upgrade Your Home
Your energy advisor will review recommended improvements with you and help coordinate any eligible upgrades with a participating contractor.
BACK TO TOP 
Home Energy Assessments
Choose from two no-cost assessment options below:
Home Energy Assessment
During your assessment, an energy advisor may:


Perform your walk-through Energy Assessment at no cost.
Visually inspect your home’s insulation, air sealing, and heating and cooling systems.
Identify opportunities to reduce energy use and improve comfort.
Install complimentary energy-saving products and light air sealing measures.
Provide energy-saving recommendations and educational materials.
Recommend next steps for additional energy-efficiency improvements or programs.
BACK TO TOP 
Home Energy Assessment Plus (if qualified)
Includes everything in the Home Energy Assessment, plus:

A more comprehensive Energy Assessment at no cost.
Blower door testing to identify areas where heated or cooled air may be escaping.
Additional diagnostic testing to identify opportunities for weatherization improvements.
Combustion safety observations and exterior gas leak inspections for certain projects. *
Smart thermostat installation for qualifying purchases. **
Please allow extra time for this assessment, as it includes a more in-depth evaluation of your home.

*Gas leak testing from the meter to appliances is not included during an Assessment. Gas leak testing is provided with a Whole Home Energy Solutions project as part of the test-in and test-out protocol.

**Smart thermostat installation applies to qualifying thermostats purchased through the RECO Marketplace.
